summary.zh: DSH 桌面 MCP 工作台：在浏览器里管理 MCP 连接、试运行工具、复核工具变更与排查故障；Web 工作台与 dsh-go 手机原生面板共用同一组服务器。
summary.en: MCP workbench for DSH desktop (DSH Web): manage this host’s MCP connections, run tools, review definition changes and troubleshoot failures. The Web workbench and the dsh-go native panel share the same servers.
